products.eligibility_rules: Eligible if all apply: permanently live in Australia; eligible for Medicare; purchasing as a consumer (not GST‑registered entity); no prior fraud-related insurance refusal/decline/voidance; access to an email address. Must return home at end of trip. Cover can be purchased even if journey has already begun; cancellation cover starts from purchase date; other cover starts when you depart home.
products.age_eligibility_notes: Benefits are based on age at the date insurance starts. Personal Accident - Loss of life is only payable if aged 16–80 at the date insurance starts.
products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 14 days if trip hasn’t started and no claim. After 14 days, full refund less $35 cancellation fee if trip hasn’t started and no claim.
products.excess_options: You can choose whether to have an excess. One excess applies per unexpected event even if multiple sections are claimed. No excess applies to Personal Accident (D.4), Personal Liability (D.5) or Rental Vehicle Excess (D.6).

products.limit_basis_notes: Most limits apply per person per journey. One excess per unexpected event across sections. No excess for Personal Accident (D.4), Personal Liability (D.5) or Rental Vehicle Excess (D.6).
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Domestic policy does not cover medical treatment or evacuation. Diagnosed pre‑existing medical conditions are not automatically covered; you may apply via medical assessment when purchasing. SCTI may offer, decline or exclude cover; extra premium and written confirmation required. Undiagnosed conditions and those not disclosed are excluded. Changes to health between purchase and departure must be disclosed; limited cancellation cover may apply if a doctor certifies unfit to travel. Claims for scheduled/wait‑listed procedures are excluded even if the condition is covered.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: No cover for medical treatment or evacuation. Pregnancy covered up to the end of the 23rd week + 6 days (within 24th week) provided no prior complications; multiple and assisted-conception pregnancies included to the same gestational limit. Common symptoms (e.g., nausea, heartburn) are not covered. Pregnancy complications within last 3 years are treated as pre‑existing and require assessment/approval. Serious complications may allow claims under D.1/D.2 if an obstetric specialist certifies not fit to travel or unsafe for unborn child. No cover after 24 weeks’ gestation.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: ‘Relevant person’ includes immediate family, travelling companion, or a person directly related to the trip’s primary purpose. Limited cover only where the relevant person dies, is (or is recommended to be) admitted for non‑elective inpatient care, is admitted to or recommended for end‑stage palliative care, or is diagnosed with a terminal condition or condition requiring radiotherapy/chemotherapy; the person must not have resided in a rest home or required equivalent home care before policy start.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers the non‑refundable excess charged by a licensed rental company if a rented vehicle is stolen or damaged due to an unexpected event. Vehicle must be a standard model car or motorhome (max 8 persons) or a moped/motorbike up to 200cc (or 15kW electric). Driver must be named on Certificate of Insurance and rental agreement, comply with laws (e.g., licence, speed/BAL), and drive on formed/paved roads or carparks. No cover for off‑road, unnamed drivers, or where the rental company should refund the excess. Personal liability arising from driving a rental vehicle is excluded.
products.luggage_conditions: Unattended property and public place rules apply. No cover for items left unattended in public places; at weddings/festivals unless checked into a ticketed cloakroom; in locked vehicles at night; in any unlocked vehicles or premises. Watches and jewellery not covered if left unattended in vehicles, not carried on person while using transport providers, or left in accommodation unless in a safe/locker. Cameras/electronics not covered if in checked baggage, left unattended with transport providers, in locked vehicles not concealed in a locked boot/compartment, in unlocked vehicles/premises, or sent by post/courier/freight. Cash, passports, ID, bank cards and travel documents are not covered.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for governmental directives/restrictions/quarantine/detention (e.g., state border closures, lockdowns). Natural events covered only if they begin after policy purchase (D.1) or after journey start (others). Travellers are advised to check if destinations have been “in the news” for severe weather or natural disasters before booking/travelling, as these may not be unexpected events.
products.claims_process_summary: Make claims online at www.scti.com.au/claims and upload supporting documents. Before claiming: prevent further loss; obtain written reports for lost/stolen/damaged items (police/airline); block IMEI for lost/stolen phones and keep proof; seek refunds/credits/compensation from other parties first; preserve items. After lodging: follow SCTI/Southern Cross Emergency Assistance instructions; provide proof and documents; give authority to act; refer any third‑party claims to SCTI without admitting liability. After acceptance: assist subrogation; provide damaged items if requested; notify SCTI if property is recovered.
products.emergency_assistance_details: Southern Cross Emergency Assistance: +61 2 9293 7999 (24/7). Use for emergencies (not general or claims queries).
products.premium_factors: Number and ages of travellers; whether including dependent or non‑dependent children; trip length; chosen excess; specified items and their values; pre‑existing medical conditions cover; cruise cover; government taxes (GST).

products._notes: Single domestic plan with optional cruise add‑on. No domestic medical or evacuation cover. COVID‑19 cover messaging conflicts with section‑level pandemic exclusions; see _document_notes for ambiguity. Jewellery sub‑limit wording varies between tables; item/sub‑aggregate values taken from the benefits table on page 10.

data._document_notes: Ambiguity: Page 8 states “You’re covered for COVID-19... includes cover for unexpected events relating to COVID-19”, but D.1.4 (p.37) and D.2.7 (p.44) exclude “anything related to an epidemic or pandemic”. No domestic medical cover applies in any case. Also, the unspecified jewellery sub‑limit formatting on page 46 appears inconsistent with the clearer benefits table on page 10; extraction uses the page 10 table amounts ($1,500 per item; $2,500 total per person).
